notes.title: Update 5.7
notes.content:
In this update:
• increased damage to the boss and aircraft
• increased lifespan of enemy missiles
• increased life expectancy of shock missiles
• increased lifespan of missile kits, repairs and improvements to the gun

notes.title: Update 5.6
notes.content:
In this update:
• redesigned helicopter braking system
• fixed bug with water at level 1
• fixed bug with buried units at level 2
• redesigned the system of enemy helicopters, now they move back only when approaching the hero

notes.title: Update 5.5
notes.content:
Hello everybody.
In this update:
• Helicopter maneuverability increased 2.5 times
• Slightly modified missile launch system
• A new option in the game settings will allow you to select the number of explosions.

notes.title: Update 5.4
notes.content:
In this update:
• fixed an old bug with the trembling of a helicopter and an airplane when launching missiles
• fixed a bug with an invisible cursor that did not appear when winning / losing
• cosmetic changes to the main menu

notes.title: Update 5.3
notes.content:
In this update:
∙ fixed a bug with the movement of the helicopter when it reached the finish line and during the pause.
∙ when faced with an obstacle, life is taken away.
∙ the textures of the burnt equipment became dark.

notes.title: Update 5.2
notes.content:
[h1]What's New in Version 1.5.2:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with incorrect display of Stingers in Confrontation mode
[*]Changed the color of the interface in Confrontation mode
[*]Improved control of helicopter and aircraft
[*]Enemy missile life span is increased to 5 seconds
[*]Shock-rockets cause an explosion when confronted with an enemy
[*]Improved call of Artillery and Missile Fire in Confrontation mode
[*]Revised missile guidance system for helicopters and aircraft. Now the rockets are fired at random
[/list]

notes.title: Update 5.1
notes.content: The new bug with WorkShop has been fixed. When the helicopter did not change the image.

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Fixed bug with non-working achievements.
Easy redesign of the main menu.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content: The new version has some levels redone.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content: In this update, we added the "Afterburner" mode, a new map for the "Confrontation" mode, as well as the ability to launch a nuclear missile at the level of General 7.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content: Some bugs have been fixed in this update.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
In the new version, I fixed the bug with no enemies when the player flew outside the screen. 
From new:
Added button Back in the main menu, and also added the ability to enable and disable the visibility of the mouse during the game.
